projects.name: Gender & Video Game Dialogue (in progress)
summary: Collected and processed 247,644 dialogue lines from 3,043 characters across 18 role-playing video games using the Video Game Dialogue Corpus.
Conducted emotion classification (RoBERTa) to analyze gender differences in emotional expression.
Performed Part-of-Speech (spaCy) tagging and TF-IDF vectorization (scikit-learn) to identify the verbs most uniquely associated with each gender.
Utilized regular expressions to examine gender differences in the distribution of terminal punctuation.

projects.name: A Chat Application
summary: Designed the frontend of a chat application (HTML & CSS) with features such as a navigation bar, interactive hover effects, and responsive layout adaptation.
Developed the backend of a chat application (Flask) with features such as user account management, channel-based communication, and real-time messaging for text, emojis, and image sharing.

projects.name: Scholarly Article Classification
summary: Collected and processed metadata of 1.7 million scholarly articles from the arXiv Dataset.
Performed Multinomial Logistic Regression (Apache Spark) on AWS to identify latent topics across articles.
Trained a Latent Dirichlet Allocation model (Apache Spark) on AWS to classify articles into research fields.

projects.name: Urban Gentrification
projects.summary: Designed an agent-based model (Mesa) to simulate urban gentrification dynamics, examining how citizens and immigrants with varying socioeconomic status interact and relocate within a city.

projects.name: Funding & Academic Output
summary: Collected and processed 4,959 funding records from U.S. NSF Division of Behavioral and Cognitive Sciences.
Scraped metadata of 207,370 scholarly articles authored by 3,230 identified researchers from Google Scholar
Applied k-means clustering and TF-IDF vectorization (scikit-learn) to examine the relationship between seven identified fields and funding amounts.
Utilized a Structural Topic Model (R) to analyze temporal trends across 12 identified topics.
Performed document embeddings (SciBERT) to assess the impact of funding on research diversity.

projects.name: Video Game Classification
summary: Collected and processed metadata of 75,776 video games from the Steam Games Dataset.
Trained a Random Forest Classifier (scikit-learn) to classify games based on textual descriptions.
Trained a Convolutional Neural Network (TensorFlow) to classify games based on cover art.

projects.name: Eyewitness Identification
summary: Collected and processed responses from 78 participants in a between-subjects factorial design experiment (Qualtrics).
Conducted an ANOVA test (Jamovi) to analyze the effects of lineup procedure, target availability, and confidence on eyewitness identification accuracy.

projects.name: Moral Judgment & Occupation
summary: Collected and processed responses from 285 participants in an observational study (Qualtrics)
Conducted an ANOVA test (Jamovi) to analyze the relationship between maternal occupation and moral judgments of mothers leaving their children unsupervised.
